title: @actualham first and last feed of the day
summary: Inquisitive insights And bites Of fancy As flights Of bytes Do their dancing Tongues trodding out tales And words prancing Through screens And dreams Of bites and bytes Nibbling on the earlobe of Existence #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Inquisitive insights

And bites

Of fancy

As flights 

Of bytes 

Do their dancing

Tongues trodding out tales

And words prancing

Through screens

And dreams

Of bites and bytes

Nibbling on the earlobe of

Existence

#smallpoems
